Soft natural illumination translated entirely through pencil shading. Extremely high detail, crisp fine-line work, delicate highlights, realistic depth created through pencil layering, no harsh digital gradients.

prompts.title: Oil and Light
prompts.prompt:
Create a highly detailed monochromatic portrait rendered in a classical oil painting style, painted in black-and-white grayscale with rich impasto brush texture and visible painterly strokes. The artwork should resemble a traditional museum-quality oil painting on canvas.
8K ultra-high resolution, vertical 4:5 aspect ratio.
Face Matching & Identity Accuracy

Use the attached reference image for exact facial structure and likeness accuracy. Preserve the same facial proportions, jawline structure, cheekbone shape, eye shape, nose proportions, lip structure, and overall facial symmetry. Maintain strong identity fidelity while translating skin details into painterly brush strokes.
Pose & Body Angle

The portrait uses a classic bust composition, framed from the upper chest to the top of the head.

The subject’s torso is turned slightly away from the camera (around 20–30°) while the head turns back toward the viewer, creating a natural three-quarter portrait angle. The shoulders remain relaxed and natural, with the neck upright and balanced. The subject maintains direct eye contact with a calm, gentle expression and a subtle closed-mouth smile.
Eyes

Natural eyes with subtle shadows beneath the lower eyelids and softly arched eyebrows painted with expressive brush strokes. Each eye contains a small bright catchlight in the upper-left iris, suggesting a directional light source.
Hair

Thick dark wavy hair arranged in a loose updo, with soft strands framing the face. Hair volume is created using broad painterly strokes rather than individual strands.
Lighting (Chiaroscuro)

Classic chiaroscuro lighting with a strong light source from the upper-left side of the frame. The left side of the face is illuminated while the right side falls into soft shadow, sculpting the facial structure and creating strong depth.
Texture & Brushwork

Visible impasto oil paint texture across the entire composition. Facial strokes follow the natural contours of the face while hair and clothing use broader expressive strokes.
Clothing

A simple white V-neck garment painted with loose white-gray brush strokes, keeping the viewer’s attention on the face.
Background

An abstract textured gray oil-paint background with soft tonal variations and painterly strokes that separate the subject from the background.
Style

Ultra-detailed 8K classical oil painting, realistic brushwork, dramatic tonal contrast, visible canvas texture.
